name: Gold Pocket Watch
description: A tarnished gold pocket watch, still warm to the touch. The crystal is cracked.

examination_discoveries.text: Turning it over, you find an engraving on the back: 'To E.H. — Time reveals all.' The hands are stopped at 11:47.
examination_discoveries.journal_entry: The back of the pocket watch reads: 'To E.H. — Time reveals all.' Someone's initials. The hands are frozen at 11:47 — the moment something happened.

name: Torn Note
description: Half a page torn from a letter. Something was written here in haste.

examination_discoveries.text: Holding it to the light — a faint watermark. The paper is headed stock from Harlow & Associates, Solicitors.
examination_discoveries.journal_entry: The torn note uses headed paper from Harlow & Associates. This was written on Harlow's own stationery.

name: Iron Key
description: A heavy iron key with a worn bow. A small tag reads '3' in faded ink.

name: Calling Card
description: A cream-coloured card. 'Mr. R. Harlow — Solicitor. 14 Marsh Street.' The corner is slightly singed.

examination_discoveries.text: On the back, in pencil, a single word: 'Thursday.' Underlined twice.
examination_discoveries.journal_entry: The back of Harlow's calling card has 'Thursday' written in pencil and underlined. The torn note mentions a Thursday meeting.
